CustomObject.description: Finance Center: expected receipts per project per month, rebuilt nightly by FinanceCollectionStateBatch from unpaid Cash_Flow__c remaining amounts, in the project currency. Live lines (Is_Frozen = false) are deleted and recreated every run. On the first run of each month a FROZEN copy of that month is created and never rebuilt - forecast-vs-actual variance compares the frozen line against actual receipts, and Slippage_Reason__c is edited on frozen lines.
CustomObject.label: Finance Forecast Line
